entities.summary: Richard Rhondel James Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver and return specialist in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the seventh round of the 2018 NFL draft. He also played for the New York Giants and Kansas City Chiefs. With the Chiefs, he won Super Bowl LVIII.
